notes.brackenridge: Centre of OSM's Brackenridge Hall Dormitory (way/126134747, ref BHD, 207 East 21st Street). The school data gives Brackenridge Roberts Hall's address (303 E 21st St), which pinned it to Roberts.
notes.BLD: BLD is Blanton Residence Hall in UT's list (the hall itself); the word rule had put it on the Blanton Museum of Art.
notes.JCD: JCD is Jester Residence Hall in UT's list (the hall itself); Jester Center keeps its academic code JES.
notes.LTD: LTD is Littlefield Residence Hall in UT's list (the hall itself), not the Littlefield Carriage House.
notes.MCA: MCA is the Moody Center arena in UT's list; the word rule had put it on the Moody Bank Tower downtown.
notes.south-end-zone: Darrell K Royal stadium's south end zone, varsity athletics, not a class building.
notes.caven-clark-field-support-building: Varsity field support building at Clark Field, not a class building.
notes.richard-mithoff-track-and-soccer-fieldho: Varsity track and soccer fieldhouse, not a class building.
notes.moncrief-neuhaus-athletic-center: Varsity athletics center at the stadium, not a student gym.

detours.why: The Biomedical Engineering Building (way/172047174) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drives on its east side, so walks from the halls west of University Avenue cross the avenue and go round to them.

Andrews and Carothers sit west of University Avenue and their mapped paths lead out by the steps and service drive on their far sides; Burdine Hall's doors face University Avenue, so walks go round the halls to the avenue first.
Blanton Hall (way/79457851) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drive on its west side, so walks east start by going round the building.
Dobie Twenty21 (way/42807636) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drive south of it, so the walk goes south and round by the mapped crossing to the east.
Neither Jester West (relation/1715386) nor the Blanton Museum (relation/20972967) has a mapped entrance; their centres snap to paths on their far sides, so the walk goes round both by Speedway.

Patton Hall (relation/4464605) has no mapped entrance and is reached by the footways east of it; Roberts Hall's mapped doors lead out to Jester Circle, so the walk goes east round the block before turning north.
